name: Send Campaign for Client Approval
description: On each change to Client Review Submitted At, sends the existing Slack and email notices for the current Client Review submission. A per-submission audit suppresses completed reruns and blocks uncertain retries. Does not change the 48-hour review deadline. Existing pending records are not backfilled by publishing.

nodes.description: Checks the campaign still matches the captured submission timestamp and is in Client Review without an approval exception. Skips completed duplicate submissions, blocks uncertain prior attempts, and records a new claim before allowing the existing Slack/email actions. No messages are sent by this step and review timing is unchanged.

nodes.description: Records that the preceding slack action succeeded for this submission. Preserves the submission audit and refuses a mismatched claim. After Slack, rechecks the current submission and review stage before email. Does not send messages or change review timing.
Reads the campaign's linked lead list and formats its targeting fields for the existing client review email. Does not change records or send messages.

Immediately before email, checks that the same claimed submission is still current, still in Client Review, is not exempt, and has a successful Slack action recorded. This check is read-only and sends nothing.
